en.blurb_leader: %{name} is the chieftain of %{clan}. The guardianship of all Tribe members has been entrusted to them by the trust of their peers. The chieftain is the highest authority in the Tribe. The chieftain holds Tribe meetings, determines mentors for new trainees, and names new scouts. To help them protect the Tribe, they don armor made from the shell of a Red Centipede. They typically take the suffix "star".
en.blurb_deputy: %{name} is a %{clan} elite. The elites are the second in command, just below the chieftain. They advise the chieftain and organize daily patrols, alongside normal scout duties. Typically, an elite is personally appointed by the current chieftain. Elites are expected to have mentored at least one trainee before earning their role. An elite succeeds the chieftain if they die or retire.
en.blurb_warrior: %{name} is a scout. Scouts are adult scavengers who feed and protect their Tribe. They are trained to find food and fight along with watching for dangers that may approach the Tribe. Scouts are essential to the survival of a Tribe, and usually make up the bulk of its members.
en.blurb_elder: %{name} is an elder. They have spent many cycles serving their Tribe, and have earned their eternal rest. Elders are essential to passing down the oral tradition of the Tribe before they depart, usually alone, on a Pilgrimage to ascend. Sometimes, scavengers may retire due to disability or injury. Whatever the circumstance of their retirement, elders are held in high esteem in the Tribe and always eat before scouts and merchants.
en.blurb_medicine_cat: %{name} is a merchant. Merchants are the healers of the Tribe and overseers of the Tribe's resources and wealth. They treat injuries and illnesses with herbal remedies, and craft supplies and weapons so the scouts may be safer on patrol. Unlike Scouts, merchants are not expected to search and fight for the Tribe. In addition to their healing duties, merchants are tasked with communicating with other tribes and trading, and are to be treated well even by enemy Tribes.
en.blurb_mediator: %{name} is a mediator. Mediators are not typically required to hunt or fight for the Tribe. Rather, mediators are charged with handling disagreements between Tribe mates and disputes between Tribes. Some mediators train to serve their Tribe, while others may choose to become mediators later in life.
en.blurb_apprentice: %{name} is a trainee, working to become a scout. Kits can be made trainee scouts at six twelfth turns, where they will learn how to search and fight for their Tribe. Typically, the training of a trainee is entrusted to a single scout — their mentor. To build character, trainees are often assigned the unpleasant and grunt tasks of Tribe life.
en.blurb_medcat_app: %{name} is a trainee merchant, training to become a full merchant. Kits can be made trainee merchants at six twelfth turns, where they will learn how to heal their Tribe and manage trade and resources. Trainee merchants are typically chosen for their interest in healing and/or their aversion to violence.
en.blurb_mediator_app: %{name} is a trainee mediator, training to become a full mediator. Mediators are in charge of handling disagreements both within the Tribe and between Tribes where merchants typically trade with individuals. Trainee mediators are often chosen for their quick thinking and steady personality.
en.blurb_kitten: %{name} is a kit. All scavengers below the age of six twelfth turns are considered kits. Kits are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the wild. Although they don't have any official duties in the Tribe, they are expected to learn the legends and traditions of their Tribe. They are protected by every member of the Tribe and always eat first.
en.blurb_newborn: %{name} is a newborn. Little baby. Fresh out the oven.
en.blurb_unknown: %{name} has an unknown rank. I guess they want to make their own way in life!
